subject: Onboarding kickoff: ops play-deck, milestone checklist & availability
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@lumencloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: LumenCloud PMO <pmo@lumencloud.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding kickoff: ops play-deck, milestone checklist & availability

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday — LumenCloud is excited to get started. Before we lock in dates, can you share a condensed mutual action plan (MAP) that maps milestones to the specific Redwood owners and indicates any blockers we should be aware of?

High-level asks from our side:
- Target pilot start: week of Aug 9 (flexible by 1–2 weeks)
- Need SOC2 evidence & network diagram by July 16 for internal approval
- Identification of the person owning DNS/proxy changes (we can coordinate change window)

We can share calendar availability for our PM and infra lead — sending that now from PMO.

Elena
Elena Torres
Senior Product Manager | LumenCloud
elena.torres@lumencloud.com

-----Original Message-----
From: LumenCloud PMO <pmo@lumencloud.com>
Sent: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 08:58:00 -0700

Subject: Availability: PM/Infra windows (attached)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@lumencloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding kickoff: ops play-deck, milestone checklist & availability

Elena — thanks, and great to see the availability. I put together a short MAP and an implementation checklist to make milestones and owners explicit. Attaching the spreadsheet (Lumen_MAP_v0.2.xlsx) and a one-page dependency summary (implementation-deps.pdf).

Key milestones (summary):
1) Pre-provisioning sign-off (owner: Marissa) — due 2026-07-09 — deliverables: signed SOW, access matrix, compliance intake answers
2) Infrastructure readiness (owner: Irene Choi, infra lead) — due 2026-07-23 — deliverables: test cluster, network peering stub, credential handoff
3) Pilot integration & smoke tests (owner: Ben Carter) — due 2026-08-06 — deliverables: test prompts, latency targets, runbook
4) Pilot launch (joint) — target week of 2026-08-09 — go/no-go checklist included in the MAP

Open items / risk flags:
- SOC2 artifact delivery timeline: we can provide the latest audit statement and network diagram by 2026-07-14, but system-level logs may take additional coordination (Irene will own).
- DNS/proxy changes: please confirm who at Lumen will approve the change window; Ben is ready to work with your infra team.

Next steps I propose:
- Quick 30-min alignment on Monday 2026-06-29 to confirm owners and patch dates in the spreadsheet
- Ben to schedule a 60-min infra deep-dive with your infra lead the week of 2026-07-06

Attachments: Lumen_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (MAP draft), implementation-deps.pdf (dependency summary)

Thanks — attaching the two files here.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Direct: +1 (415) 555-0199

(Attachment stubs: Lumen_MAP_v0.2.xlsx [spreadsheet], implementation-deps.pdf [PDF summary])

Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding kickoff: ops play-deck, milestone checklist & availability

Marissa — received, thank you. The MAP looks clear and the dates line up with our internal timeline except for one ask: can you move the infrastructure readiness milestone one week earlier (to 2026-07-16)? That would help our security review schedule.

Also: we need a short list of the exact SOC2 artifacts you'll provide by 2026-07-14 so our compliance team can pre-clear them. Can you (or Irene) drop that into the doc?

Availability: PM and infra lead can do a 30-min sync on Mon 06/29 between 10:00–12:00 PT.

Elena

Quick update from infra/resource side — happy to shift the Infra readiness milestone to 2026-07-16 to match Lumen's security window. Irene and I reviewed the dependency doc and noted two items that must be complete before the earlier date:

1) VPN/peering stub configured in test environment (owner: Lumen infra / supported by Ben) — ETA: 2026-07-09
2) Service account and onboarding credentials supplied to Redwood (owner: Lumen PMO) — ETA: 2026-07-12

I'll create a shared scheduling sheet and drop the live link here for the Monday sync; please add names for your infra lead so we can send the invite.

Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ExampleScheduleLink

If Lumen can confirm the two ETAs above, we will update the MAP and send v0.3 immediately after the Monday call.

Thanks —
